title: Prayer
definition: Prayer is communicating with God through worship, thanksgiving, confession, dependence, intercession, and faith.
summary: Prayer is the believer's God-given way of seeking the Lord, casting burdens on Him, confessing sin, giving thanks, and depending on His grace.
christFocus: Through Christ, believers have direct access to the Father and may approach Him with confidence.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Prayer is the believer's God-given way of seeking the Lord, casting burdens on Him, confessing sin, giving thanks, and depending on His grace.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, understand Scripture clearly, and live with hope, obedience, and discernment.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, endurance, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
